app.tagline: Find music and request it with one click.

common.secretSetHint: Stored. Leave empty to keep it.

footer.sources: Data from MusicBrainz, ListenBrainz and Cover Art Archive

setup.title: Welcome to nexbeat
setup.intro: Create the first account. It becomes the admin and sets up Lidarr, mail and all further accounts.
setup.usernameHint: 3 to 32 characters: letters, digits, dot, hyphen, underscore.

onboarding.invitationIntro: This invitation is for {{email}}. Choose a name and a password.
onboarding.resetDone: The new password is active. All previous sessions have ended.
onboarding.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
onboarding.forgotIntro: Enter the address of your account. You will get a link for a new password.
onboarding.forgotSent: If there is an account for this address, the link is on its way. It is valid for one hour.

discover.heroTitle: What will you listen to next
discover.heroIntro: New artists that match what you already listen to. Preview, request, done.
discover.forYouHint: Built from your requests and the library. Artists that match several come first.
discover.becauseHint: Similar artists that are not in the library yet.
discover.trendingHint: What the ListenBrainz community listens to most this week.
discover.emptyUser: Recommendations grow from the library and your requests. Pick something and it gets going.
discover.emptyAdmin: Connect Lidarr and the library produces the first recommendations.

search.title: Search
search.intro: Artists, albums, EPs and singles from MusicBrainz.
search.idle: Type at least two letters. The search covers the whole MusicBrainz database.

artist.noReleases: MusicBrainz lists no releases for this.
artist.similarHint: Keep clicking. Your path stays here.
artist.similarOff: Similar artists are off because ListenBrainz is switched off in the settings.

artistRequest.title: Request every album by {{name}}?
artistRequest.text: Lidarr fetches every studio album that is missing and each new album from now on. EPs, singles, live recordings and compilations stay out.

album.noTracks: MusicBrainz has no track list for this release yet.

request.title: Request
request.availableHint: Lidarr already has this release complete.
request.dryRunSent: Dry run: not sent to Lidarr
request.notReady: Requests are not set up yet
request.notReadyAdmin: Connect Lidarr and pick a folder and profiles to get started.
request.notReadyUser: An admin still needs to connect Lidarr.
request.dryRunHint: Dry run is on. Requests are counted but not sent to Lidarr.
request.blockedAdmin: The metadata profile decides which types work. You can pick it here, but only change it in Lidarr.
request.blockedArtistAdmin: The artist's profile can only be changed in Lidarr. If Lidarr monitors the artist's new albums, every album of the added types will be wanted afterwards.

quota.title: Quota
quota.intro: Every request counts as one, whether album, EP or single, however large. Rejected and failed requests do not count.
quota.defaultLimitHint: Applies to all accounts without their own limit. Empty means unlimited. Admins are never limited.
quota.periodHint: The counter starts over every day, every Monday or on the first of every month.
quota.oneRequestOne: One request counts as one, however large.

myRequests.title: My requests
myRequests.intro: Everything you requested, with its state in Lidarr.
myRequests.empty: You have not requested anything yet.

adminRequests.title: All requests
adminRequests.intro: Approve, reject or send to Lidarr again.
adminRequests.rejectText: “{{title}}” will be rejected and no longer counts against the quota.

profile.title: Profile
profile.passwordIntro: After the change, all other sessions end.

address.title: Address and language
address.intro: How nexbeat is reached from outside and which language new accounts see.
address.publicUrlHint: Links in invitations and password mails point here. Empty: the address the invitation was sent from.
address.languageHint: For invitation mails and accounts without their own choice.

mail.intro: For invitations and password links. Without a mail server you get the links to pass on yourself.
mail.testIntro: Sends a short message. Without a recipient it goes to {{email}}.
mail.testBlocked: Save the server and sender address first.
mail.testSent: The test mail is on its way.

lidarr.promise: nexbeat does not change any settings in Lidarr. It only adds requested artists, monitors the requested album and starts the search.
lidarr.connectionIntro: Address and API key of Lidarr.
lidarr.apiKeyHint: In Lidarr under Settings, General, Security.
lidarr.targetIntro: Where new artists go and with which profiles. You choose from what Lidarr already has.
lidarr.metadataHint: The metadata profile applies to artists nexbeat adds. Artists already in Lidarr keep their own. If a profile excludes a kind, nexbeat stops the request before anything is added.
lidarr.profileWide: Allows more than studio albums. Whole artist requests are blocked with it, and new artists arrive in Lidarr with all of these kinds.
lidarr.dryRunIntro: For trying things out against a real Lidarr.
lidarr.dryRunToggle: Do not send requests to Lidarr
lidarr.dryRunHint: Requests are created and counted, but nothing goes to Lidarr. Under All requests they can be sent again later.
lidarr.libraryIntro: nexbeat reads the artist list from Lidarr every ten minutes. Recommendations and badges come from it.
lidarr.webhookIntro: Without a webhook nexbeat checks every two minutes. With one, Lidarr reports an import right away. nexbeat does not add it itself, you do that in Lidarr.
lidarr.webhookSteps: In Lidarr: Settings, Connect, plus, Webhook. Method POST, events: {{events}}.
lidarr.webhookLocal: Lidarr cannot reach nexbeat at localhost. Under System, Address, enter the address nexbeat has on your network.

sources.title: Sources
sources.intro: Where nexbeat gets recommendations, images and previews. Every source is a way out of your network and can be switched off.
sources.musicbrainz: Search, discography and covers. Always on, without it there is no identity.
sources.listenbrainz: Similar artists and trends from open data, no key needed. Switched off, there are no recommendations.
sources.deezer: Artist images and 30 second previews. The interface answers without a key but is not officially open. Switched off, only images and previews are missing.
sources.listenbrainzTokenHint: ListenBrainz now shares some popularity data only with a token. You find it in your settings on listenbrainz.org after signing in.

users.inviteIntro: The invitation arrives by mail. Without a mail server you get the link to pass on.
users.manualLink: Not sent by mail ({{reason}}). Pass on this link:
users.activeHint: Blocked accounts cannot sign in and are signed out everywhere.
users.requiresApprovalHint: Requests wait until an admin approves them. Otherwise they go to Lidarr right away within the quota.
users.deleteText: {{name}} and all requests of this account will be deleted. Nothing changes in Lidarr.

errors.internal: Something went wrong on the server. Request {{id}}.
errors.tooManyAttemptsSeconds: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {{count}} seconds.
errors.tooManyAttemptsMinutes: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {{count}} minutes.

byCode.invalid_input: The input does not fit. Check the fields.
byCode.internal_error: Something went wrong on the server.
byCode.invitation_invalid: This invitation is no longer valid.
byCode.email_taken: There is already an account for this address.
byCode.reset_invalid: This link is no longer valid. Ask for a new one.
byCode.invalid_email: This is not a valid email address.
byCode.lidarr_not_configured: Enter the Lidarr address and API key first.
byCode.invalid_mbid: This is not a valid MusicBrainz ID.
byCode.last_admin: The last active admin cannot be removed.
byCode.cannot_disable_self: You cannot block your own account.
byCode.invalid_quota: The quota must be between 0 and 10000.
byCode.cannot_delete_self: You cannot delete your own account here.
byCode.admin_link_needs_mail: nexbeat sends a password link for another admin by mail only. Set up mail first.
byCode.lidarr_timeout: Lidarr did not answer in time. nexbeat checks in the background whether it arrived.
byCode.lidarr_pending: The hand-over to Lidarr has not finished.
byCode.lidarr_unreachable: Lidarr cannot be reached. Are address and port right?
byCode.lidarr_path_unknown: Lidarr does not know this address. Is this really Lidarr?
byCode.mail_tls_failed: The encrypted connection failed. Does the encryption match the port?
byCode.mail_timeout: The mail server did not answer in time.
byCode.mail_connection_refused: The mail server refuses the connection. Is the port right?
byCode.mail_connect_failed: No connection to the mail server.
byCode.mail_host_unknown: There is no mail server with this name.
byCode.mail_login_failed: Signing in to the mail server failed. Are username and password right?
byCode.mail_recipient_refused: The mail server refused the recipient.
byCode.mail_sender_refused: The mail server refused the sender address.
byCode.mail_rejected: The mail server rejected the mail.
byCode.mail_not_configured: No mail server is set up.
byCode.requests_not_ready: Requests are not set up yet.
byCode.album_without_artist: MusicBrainz names no artist for this release.
byCode.already_available: This is already in the library.
byCode.artist_without_albums: MusicBrainz lists no studio albums for this artist.
byCode.artist_albums_not_in_lidarr: Lidarr lists no studio albums for this artist.
byCode.quota_exhausted: Your quota for this period is used up.
byCode.release_type_excluded: The metadata profile in Lidarr excludes this kind of release.
byCode.artist_profile_excludes_type: The artist is in Lidarr with a metadata profile that excludes this kind of release.
byCode.profile_not_studio_only: The metadata profile in the settings allows more than studio albums. A whole artist would also bring live albums, compilations or bootlegs into Lidarr.
byCode.artist_profile_not_studio_only: The artist is in Lidarr with a metadata profile that allows more than studio albums. Lidarr would also monitor future live albums, compilations or bootlegs.
byCode.album_not_in_lidarr: Lidarr does not list this release for the artist.
byCode.request_not_pending: This request is not awaiting approval.
byCode.request_not_cancellable: This request can no longer be withdrawn.
byCode.request_not_retryable: This request cannot be sent again.
byCode.request_still_checking: nexbeat is still checking whether Lidarr got this request. If needed, it can be sent again afterwards.
byCode.musicbrainz_unreachable: MusicBrainz cannot be reached right now.
byCode.musicbrainz_busy: MusicBrainz is busy right now. Try again in a moment.
byCode.listenbrainz_unavailable: ListenBrainz cannot be reached right now.
byCode.listenbrainz_token_required: ListenBrainz now only shares this with a token.
byCode.deezer_unavailable: Deezer cannot be reached right now.
byCode.dry_run: Dry run: not sent to Lidarr.
